headlines.title: Spdr Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF (DIA) Buys $40.3 Million More GS on Nov. 9
headlines.summary: The fund added $392.3 million across all 30 of its positions, with Goldman Sachs its largest buy at $40.3 million.

headlines.title: Visa’s Services Grow Over 20% as Company Pushes Beyond Payments
headlines.summary: Visa (NYSE:V) is expanding its value-added services business through faster product development, broader payment and banking capabilities, and increased investment in security, according to Andrew Torre, the company’s president of value-added services.

headlines.title: Monad Is Now a Settlement Option in Visa’s Stablecoin Program
headlines.summary: Visa hasn't announced the addition itself, and the Monad Foundation's release doesn't say which stablecoins will settle on the network.

headlines.title: Visa (V) Stock Could Be Reasonable With Excess Returns Intact
headlines.summary: Visa has delivered strong long term gains for shareholders, which puts a spotlight on whether the current share price is properly supported by the returns the business earns on its capital. With the stock now reflecting years of compounding performance and a growing role in global payments, the question is how much of those capital returns are already embedded in today’s valuation. Over the past 5 years, Visa has returned 106.

headlines.title: Global Payments adds Visa IDX API to Adaptive Authentication
headlines.summary: The payments technology company said the integration is intended to help merchants share more transaction data with card issuers.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
